citation: Crabtree CD, et al. Physiol Rep 2025;13:e70397
protocol: Bruce-protocol treadmill graded test to VO2max after an overnight fast, 2 h after a placebo drink (PL arm; BO-BD ketone ester arm to ignore); HR and gas exchange at rest, stages 1-3 and maximum
note: Bruce stages have fixed speed and grade, so dose is absolute; HR only (glucose measured before the drink only).
